plain.text: David wrote this when he was running from his son Absalom. "LORD, how many enemies I have! So many rise up against me. Many are saying, 'God will not rescue him.'"
"But you, LORD, are a shield around me. You give me honour and lift up my head. I cry out to the LORD, and he answers me from his holy mountain."
"I lie down and sleep, and I wake again, because the LORD keeps me safe. I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people surrounding me."
"Rise up, LORD! Save me, my God!" David asks God to deal with his enemies. "Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people."

summary.bigIdea: Even when surrounded by trouble, David trusts God as his shield and is able to sleep in peace.
points: David is in danger, running from his own son.
"You, O LORD, are a shield around me."
Because God keeps him safe, he can lie down and sleep.
summary.reflection: What would help you "lie down and sleep" in peace tonight, trusting God with your worries?
